ClientItems.description: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.

ClientItems.name: Energy Shell

ClientItems.description: A proud fighter emerges unscarred by time or malice. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

ClientItems.description: Become enraptured by the song of devastation. Through her, the Jade Light can be a force of destruction or a source of support.

ClientItems.description: Cast a long shadow with this lethal enforcer. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
ClientItems.name: Mesa Prime

ClientItems.description: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.

ClientItems.description: Bind the elements and unleash untold destruction with Chroma Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

ClientItems.description: Unleash the draconic. Chroma employs Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Cold to deal high damage while maintaining survivability. Soar with winged fury.

ClientItems.description: From the shadow of the long night emerges a new Excalibur.

ClientItems.description: The Inquisitor Eternal arises, hallowed by the Void, preaching a gospel of iron and flame.

ClientItems.description: As regal and lethal as a nighttime wood, this is the queen of the hunt in her ultimate form.
